items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: We had all different rhythms on this other one that I did... Bobby Rosengarden to play the 6-8 time, and me I'd just weave in between all of them.

ctx.x: "Oh no, Eddie don't do that." "Aw, don't talk back to me, you know, kidding. Oh boy. Those were good old days, boy we used to have more fun.

Just to cover one or two more odds and ends, there's in, I'm looking right now at an article that Dan Morgenstern did on you for Downbeat in the March 20, 1969 issue, it was a very nice article, and he mentioned that you had done another record with four drummers for Choral with Bobby Rosengarden, Specs Powell and Jimmy Crawford. That's before the one that you did with Krupa and Ray McKinley.

And Panama, that's right. We had all different rhythms on this other one that I did. Well one of them was that "Big Noise from Winnetka." See, and all I wanted Specs Powell to just play the tympany, Jimmy Crawford just to play that cymbal. Bobby Rosengarden to play the 6-8 time, and me I'd just weave in between all of them.
